Our two-part service includes an initial consultation where we will discuss your specific artistic and creative challenges, as well as a Q&A with our team of experienced creative professionals. We will work closely with you to help you unlock your full creative potential and achieve your goals. Our team is dedicated to providing you with the support and resources you need to succeed in your artistic and creative pursuits.

We want to ensure that you have a clear understanding of what we offer and that our service fully meets your needs. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. We are here to help you achieve your creative goals.

2. Who will be leading the consultation and second session?
	* Our team of experienced creative professionals will be leading the consultation and second session. They have a wealth of knowledge and experience in various artistic and creative fields, and are dedicated to providing you with the support and resources you need to succeed in your pursuits.
3. How long are each of the two sessions?
	* The length of each session can vary depending on the individual's needs and goals, but typically the first session lasts about an hour and the second session lasts about two hours.
4. Will the blueprint for success include specific projects that I need to complete?
	* The blueprint for success will include specific projects tailored to your needs and goals, but it's ultimately up to you to complete them. We will provide you with the support and resources you need to succeed, but the ultimate responsibility is yours.
5. Will I have access to the network of creative professionals after the second session?
	* Yes, you will have access to our network of creative professionals even after the second session, which you can use for further guidance and support. We encourage you to use this resource to continue growing and developing your artistic and creative skills.
